segs: It is stated in the Gemara
for the number of ten pesukim
that are said in Malchuyos, Zichronos and Shofaros:
one said, corresponding to the ten utterances
with which the world was created;
another said, corresponding to the Ten Commandments;
and another said, corresponding to the ten praises of Halleluyah
שֶׁמַּר אָמַר חֲדָא וּמַר אָמַר חֲדָא
that one master said one thing and another master said another,
for these three who stated opinions
were referring to the three numbers,
שֶׁל מַלְכֻיּוֹת וְשֶׁל זִכְרוֹנוֹת וְשֶׁל שׁוֹפָרוֹת,
of Malchuyos, of Zichronos and of Shofaros,
וְכָל אֶחָד מְרַמֵּז עַל עִנְיָן אֶחָד.
and each one alludes to one matter.
That is: the one who said
אָמַר הַטַּעַם עַל עֲשָׂרָה פְּסוּקֵי מַלְכֻיּוֹת,
gave the reason for the ten pesukim of Malchuyos,
כִּי זֶהוּ תַּכְלִית הַמְּכוּוָּן שֶׁל הַבְּרִיאָה,
for this is the intended purpose of Creation:
that through it there be revealed
the glory of His kingship, blessed be His Name,
by means of the ten utterances,
"On the sixth day they would say
And the one who said "corresponding to the Ten Commandments"
אָמַר הַטַּעַם עַל עֲשָׂרָה פְּסוּקֵי זִכְרוֹנוֹת,
gave the reason for the ten pesukim of Zichronos,
for they said in the Gemara
"So that your remembrance may rise before Me for good";
the merit of Yisrael will be remembered,
which is the merit of receiving the Torah,
when they received the Ten Commandments,
through which there was fixed in their hearts
the holiness of the ten sefiros,
with the ten utterances of the work of Creation,
corresponds to the aspect of Kesser Elyon,
which is "the intellect hidden from all thought,"
and it corresponds to the utterance "Bereishis,"
וְעִם כָּל זֶה לֹא נֶאֱמַר בּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר,
and nevertheless "And He said" is not stated in it,
the Commandment "I am," etc., in the form of a command,
because regarding the matter of emunah
since this is not in a person's hands
הַשָּׁגוֹת עַל סֵפֶר הַמִּצְוֹת לָרַמְבַּ״ם, מִצְוַת עֲשֵׂה א),
in his glosses on the Rambam's Sefer HaMitzvos, Positive Commandment 1);
רַק שֶׁעַל יְדֵי מַאֲמַר הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
rather, through the utterance of Hashem Yisbarach,
by this emunah shone forth in them
from the root, from the Hidden Intellect,
into the collective souls of Yisrael.
all of the Ten Commandments are stated,
up to the last, which is "You shall not covet";
and the desire in the heart
is likewise not in a person's power
but once there had already been absorbed
which are the whole of the words of Torah,
there was nullified from the heart of itself
every kind of desire for this world;
and the Commandment "You shall not covet"
is also an expression of promise:
that you will no longer have
any desire in the heart from now on.
"corresponding to the ten praises in Tehillim" —
for the ten pesukim of Shofaros.
is not an expression of prayer,
with which we praise Hashem Yisbarach
and His mercy upon all His works.
For the essence of the blowing of the shofar
is an allusion to the awakening
of the great shofar of the future,
through which will come the ultimate rectification:
to gather in the dispersed and the lost
And our own mitzvah of blowing the shofar
הוּא רַק לְהִתְעוֹרֵר עַל יְדֵי זֶה
something of the aspect of the great shofar from Above,
which is an arousal from Above
And for this comes the number
for we praise His blessed Name
עַל זֶה שֶׁהַכֹּל הוּא מִכּוֹחוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ
for this: that everything comes from His blessed power,
toward the awakening of the source and root
Therefore, in the three pesukim from the Torah
of the Giving of the Torah,
which were likewise from Him, blessed be He,
וַיְהִי קוֹל הַשּׁוֹפָר הוֹלֵךְ וְחָזֵק מְאוֹד,
"The sound of the shofar grew ever stronger,"
for at that time there truly was
like that of the time to come,
"I said, you are godly beings," etc.;
only afterward it returned, as is known.
Likewise, the pesukim of Shofaros from the Nevi'im
all speak of the shofar blasts
And in the middle are the pesukim of Shofaros
they speak of our own mitzvah of shofar,
and they are from Sefer Tehillim,
to hint that even in the deed that we perform
we know that it is not in our power
rather, we praise His blessed Name
that through an action of ours
we are included so as to reach
the aspect of the awakening of the great shofar,
"Fortunate is the people that knows the teruah"
וְכִי אֵין אֻמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם יוֹדְעִין לְהָרִיעַ?
"Do the nations of the world not know how to sound a teruah?
How many trumpets they have! etc.
Rather, it means that they know how
to win over their Creator with the teruah."
"Fortunate is the portion of the tzaddikim
who know how to direct their will
and who know how to rectify the world
on this day with the sound of the shofar;
and of this it is written,
'Fortunate is the people that knows the teruah' —
That is, the main intent of the blasts
is to fulfill the command of the Creator,
and to hear the sound of the shofar,
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה מְתַקְּנִים כָּל הָעוֹלָם,
and through this they rectify the whole world,
as it says, "to rectify the world."
And this is the meaning of "that knows the teruah":
to bring da'as into the heart;
"Da'as — this is one who recognizes his Creator."
His statutes and His judgments to Yisrael," etc.,
"His words," which are the words of Torah,
"a heritage of the congregation of Yaakov,"
and a gentile who engages in Torah is liable to death
for the nations of the world were commanded
and they are not permitted to add
any mitzvah of their own accord;
or he remains with his own law
פֶּרֶק י מֵהִלְכוֹת מְלָכִים, הֲלָכָה ט).
Therefore the people of Shechem became liable to death,
because they added the mitzvah of milah
not for the sake of conversion.
which are mitzvos that reason obligates —
they are permitted, and it is fitting for them,
to conduct themselves by them as a matter of derech eretz,
on account of the honoring of his father that he had fulfilled,
he has been sitting and honoring his parents," etc.,
even though Eisav had uprooted the name of Yisrael
and was like a Ben Noach.
"'The kindness of the nations is sin' —
all kindness that the nations do
since they do it only to aggrandize themselves, etc.;
only so that their kingdom will endure;
they do it only to show off."
In this, the sin is only
when their intent is not for the sake of Heaven;
even though these are not among the seven mitzvos.
That is because honoring parents and tzedakah
are among the mitzvos that reason obligates,
and they may fulfill them on account of reason
But of them it is said,
for with them, the judgments they do
do not bring da'as into their hearts,
the da'as of one who recognizes his Creator,
for them, the judgments too bring
da'as and recognition of the Creator into the heart.
And this is what is said,
"Fortunate is the people that knows the teruah":
the teruah brings da'as into their hearts,
for they intend to do the will of their Master,
and by this they rectify the whole world;
and "they know how to win over their Creator with the teruah."
And it all has one intent:
that through the mitzvos they recognize the Creator,
and it brings da'as into their hearts.
'for the day is holy to our Lord;
for the joy of Hashem is your strength'"
Nevertheless, it is stated in the poskim
he may fast on Rosh Hashanah,
and there is even a mitzvah in this.
and answer, 'May His great Name be blessed,'
HaKadosh Baruch Hu shakes His head:
אַשְׁרֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ שֶׁמְּקַלְּסִין אוֹתוֹ בְּבֵיתוֹ כָּךְ,
'Fortunate is the King who is praised thus in His house!
מַה לּוֹ לָאָב שֶׁהִגְלָה אֶת בָּנָיו,
What is there for the Father who exiled His children,
who were exiled from their Father's table!'"
שֶׁבְּרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה כְּשֶׁשָּׁמְעוּ אָז הַדִּבְרֵי תוֹרָה
on Rosh Hashanah, when they then heard the words of Torah
that there were claims against them,
although they did have dread and fear,
they also came from this to sadness.
"for the day is holy to our Lord":
brings fear and dread into the heart,
as this day is called in the Tikkunim
it should not bring you to sadness.
For Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
is named for laughter and joy,
and so it is in the holy Zohar
(מִדְרַשׁ הַנֶּעְלָם תּוֹלְדוֹת, חֵלֶק א קלה, א):
the offspring of laughter and joy," etc.
וְהַיְינוּ שֶׁמִּדַּת יִצְחָק הוּא פַּחַד יִצְחָק,
That is, the attribute of Yitzchak is "the Fear of Yitzchak";
לֹא בָּרָא הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא אֶת עוֹלָמוֹ
only so that they should fear Him,
'And God has made it so that they should fear Him.'"
(end of the sixth chapter of Avos, 6:11):
כָּל מַה שֶּׁבָּרָא הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא בְּעוֹלָמוֹ
"Everything that HaKadosh Baruch Hu created in His world
He created only for His glory," etc.;
that is, that there be a revelation
of the glory of the kingship of Heaven.
"a king whose awe is upon you."
And when they accept the yoke of His kingship,
אָז יֵשׁ לַהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ שִׂמְחָה מִזֶּה,
then Hashem Yisbarach has joy from it,
for this was the purpose of Creation, as stated.
And from this joy sprouts forth for Yisrael too,
(תַּנָּא דְבֵי אֵלִיָּהוּ רַבָּה רֵישׁ פֶּרֶק ג):
(Tanna d'Vei Eliyahu Rabbah, beginning of chapter 3):
"my joy is from within my fear."
And this is what he told them,
that the fear and dread should not bring them
"for the joy of Hashem is your strength";
for this, that Hashem Yisbarach rejoices
and in their acceptance of His kingship upon themselves,
since through this He will bring joy
שֶׁיִּשְׂרָאֵל עוֹנִין יְהֵא שְׁמוֹ הַגָּדוֹל מְבֹרָךְ וְכוּלֵּי,
that Yisrael answer "May His great Name be blessed," etc.,
He says, "Fortunate is the King," etc.,
and "What is there for the Father,"
and "woe to the children who were exiled."
Therefore now, at a time of Churban,
it is permitted to fast as well.
הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ שָׂמֵחַ בְּקַבָּלַת עֹל מַלְכוּתוֹ
Hashem Yisbarach rejoices in the acceptance of the yoke of His kingship
שֶׁכָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל מְקַבְּלִין עֲלֵיהֶם בְּרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה
that all Yisrael take upon themselves on Rosh Hashanah,
and "the joy of Hashem is your strength" —
that were made known to them."
That is, the words entered their hearts,
for "understood" is related to "Binah is the heart"
וְהִכְנִיס בָּהֶם עַל יְדֵי זֶה גַּם הַדַּעַת,
and through this it brought da'as into them as well,
and it was "my joy from within my fear."
And the joy that comes through fear
that the reason the Sages forbade a cow's horn
is that "an accuser cannot become a defender,"
it is considered as if inside" —
that is, in the Kodesh HaKodashim,
the Kohen Gadol does enter in garments of gold.
"And wisdom — from where, ayin, is it found?":
from the place called Kodesh HaKodashim";
and it explains that the aspect of Ayin
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר חֵלֶק ב סד, ב).
and the Kodesh HaKodashim corresponds to Kesser Elyon.
Once I entered to offer the incense, etc.,
and I saw Achtariel Yah, Hashem Tzeva'os,
sitting upon a throne high and exalted."
is the name of Kesser Elyon,
for it contains the letters of "Kesser."
There is also proof from what he said,
"'Your throne is established from then' — az — etc.
The king stands upon the platform
Since You created Your world You are He,
but since You stood at the Sea
and we sang before You with 'Az,'
This is what they said in the holy Zohar
and shines to every side," etc.;
which is the aspect of the revelation of Atika.
Thus, with the revelation of the attribute of Atika,
שֶׁנִּקְרָא אָז ה׳ יוֹשֵׁב עַל כִּסֵּא.
so that Hashem is then called "sitting upon a throne."
and the Ancient of Days sat."
And the mitzvah is to hear the sound of the shofar
(רֹאשׁ, רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה פֶּרֶק ד סִימָן י;
for Hashem Yisbarach too is called
"Who hears the sound of the shofar and gives ear to the teruah"
in the text of the Shofaros blessing,
"And you shall walk in His ways";
to hear the sound of the shofar.
And Hashem Yisbarach sits upon the throne
where the attribute of Kesser Elyon is revealed;
and this is what they said in the Gemara cited above:
And as for its saying "since it is for remembrance" —
the intent follows what they said
"Shamor is in the heart and not in any other place" —
the aspect of "the mother of the children";
"remembering is in the male, in the brain," etc.,
"and therefore Zachor is for the male
וְהוּא עַל דֶּרֶךְ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ
It is along the lines of what they said in the holy Zohar
"Zachor is a place that has no forgetting
and where forgetting has no place";
that is, the aspect of Atika;
in the Musaf of Rosh Hashanah, in the Zichronos blessing,
כִּי אֵין שִׁכְחָה לִפְנֵי כִּסֵּא כְבוֹדֶךָ,
"For there is no forgetting before Your throne of glory";
that is, "the Ancient of Days sat."
And this is the upper tip of the Yud,
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר חֵלֶק ג סה, ב);
and the letters Yud-Hei of the Name Havayah
there shines forth from Kesser Elyon into Chochmah.
And this is "Zachor — remembering is in the brain,"
into which there shines from Kesser Elyon
through the crownlet of the upper Yud.
And this is what they said:
"Since it is for remembrance, it is considered as if inside" —
that is, in the innermost Sanctum.
regarding the blood of the bull
that it is permitted for this reason:
"since it has changed, it has changed."
It is difficult: why did it not ask from the shofar,
but the sound of the shofar alone?
And that is a stronger case than the blood of the bull,
where something of the bull's body enters,
whereas here nothing at all enters
of the substance of the bull,
only the sound of the shofar.
But from this it is clear
that the sound of the shofar rises on high
וְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ שׁוֹמֵעַ מִשָּׁם הַקּוֹל שׁוֹפָר,
and Hashem Yisbarach hears the sound of the shofar from there;
rather, Hashem Yisbarach, as it were,
and as for Yisrael, at the time they blow,
the one blowing with the shofar is then
as if he had entered the Kodesh HaKodashim.
And this is what they said:
"Since it is for remembrance, it is considered as if inside" —
as though the one blowing were standing
and the shofar has not changed at all
מִכְּפִי מַה שֶּׁהָיָה עַל גּוּף הַפָּר,
from how it was on the body of the bull;
and because of this it is well understood
why the Sages forbade a cow's horn.
